svg.aria-label: Plan of the Fulcrum Twin hall: 243.8 by 182.9 metres, inbound docks on the north wall, outbound docks on the south wall, reserve racking in the middle, pack and sort south of it, returns north-east, offices and cafeteria on the south-west mezzanine, trailer yards north and south.
svg.text: Fulcrum Twin, hall plan for approval, task 0.2
800 × 600 ft (243.8 × 182.9 m, 480,000 sq ft) on a 50 ft column grid · 62 dock doors · flow-through, inbound north to outbound south · 1 px = 0.25 m
